name: Brittany Hollis

five_sec.what_is_it: A recipe app with meal plans and grocery lists
five_sec.who_for: People who save a lot of recipes and like to plan
five_sec.trust_why: 4.8 on the App Store and 4.7 on Google Play right at the top, but I've never heard of it
five_sec.next_step: Scroll looking for 'Walmart' and a price
five_sec.delivers_food_why: App Store and Google Play buttons and 'Grocery Lists'; it's just an app

full_page.what_stopped_me: Walmart isn't named anywhere on the home page; I'd have to save my own recipes off Pinterest, and it's $5.95/mo after the trial on top of what I pay eMeals
full_page.whats_missing: Walmart pickup cart, sample kid dinners

PTE.quote: 4.8 stars is cute but y'all, where's Walmart? I don't have time to clip recipes while I scroll with a baby on my hip.

five_sec.what_is_it: Plans dinner and puts the grocery list in your Walmart or Instacart cart
five_sec.who_for: Families who want dinner figured out
five_sec.trust_why: 'Powered by Instacart' helps and 'no card needed' is right there, but no App Store rating and I've never heard the name
five_sec.next_step: Tap 'See a sample week' to see if it's normal kid food
five_sec.delivers_food_why: The green line under the paragraph literally says 'We don't deliver food'

full_page.what_stopped_me: I already paid eMeals for the year and it works with my Walmart+ pickup. Not sure DinnerDrop's Walmart cart works the exact same way with Walmart+. 'Over 500 families' feels small next to eMeals. The text-voting thing is useless with a 6, 4 and 1-year-old
full_page.whats_missing: A screenshot of the filled Walmart cart with a pickup slot; App Store rating; how swapping a meal changes the list

DD.quote: Chicken tenders, taco night, English muffin pizzas for $64? That's literally my kids' menu. Free with a Walmart cart beats my $60 eMeals... if the cart actually works.

five_sec.what_is_it: eMeals, the meal plan app I already use
five_sec.trust_why: I've used it for a year and it sends my list to Walmart
five_sec.delivers_food_why: 'How It Works' with a phone and a checklist; 'Choose Your Meals'

full_page.what_stopped_me: Nothing really; I renew every year. Price isn't on the page though, and the food pictures are fancy (bok choy, rosemary-mustard pork chops)
full_page.whats_missing: Price on the page, kid food in the photos

EM.quote: Big Walmart logo, Kroger, Aldi... that's why I stay. But Shrimp Po' Boys as 'Budget Friendly'? My 6-year-old would cry.

five_sec.what_is_it: An AI app that picks meals for you
five_sec.trust_why: 'Trusted by 90,000+ families' but the big orange button is a 'Letter from the CEO', which is weird
five_sec.delivers_food_why: Phone says 'I've picked out meals for you' and 'How was it?' like a food delivery app

full_page.what_stopped_me: Meals page says a 1-month trial and prices in the app; pricing page says $25 a month for Everyday, counted in messages
full_page.whats_missing: A straight price and a Walmart pickup example

OL.quote: $25 a month to text a robot about dinner? Girl, eMeals is $60 a year.

five_sec.who_for: People who want food shipped to them
five_sec.trust_why: 'Open a box to reveal your offer' is a game, not a price
five_sec.next_step: Tap 'Continue Without Offer' and probably leave
five_sec.delivers_food_why: HelloFresh boxes in the pop-up and 'Free Meals'

full_page.what_stopped_me: No price until you type a zip; fine print says auto-renewing and shipping after the first box; feeding 5 with a box is crazy money

HF.quote: I'm not playing open-a-box to find out what dinner costs. Shipping fee after the first box? Nope.

dd_offer.why: It says no card like four times and the FAQ says you go back to the free plan
dd_offer.expect_day_15: The family texting stuff turns off and I'm back on the free plan. Nothing charged.

head_to_head.reason: eMeals already sends my list to my Walmart+ pickup and I trust it; DinnerDrop is the one I'd try free before my January renewal

EM.reason: Proven with my Walmart+ account and 'two million customers' vs 'over 500 families'; switching isn't worth it until I've tested DinnerDrop's Walmart cart

PTE.reason: DinnerDrop is free and names Walmart; Plan to Eat never mentions it

OL.reason: $0 with a Walmart cart vs $25 a month

HF.reason: I can see what a week costs ($64) without a zip code or a box game

dd_fix_that_would_move_me: Home page, next to 'One tap -> Instacart or Walmart': a real screenshot of the filled Walmart cart with a pickup time and the words 'works with Walmart+ pickup', plus the App Store rating.
